title: Wire EDM Studio — Full Pipeline Wizard (Import → Program)
brief: Replace the Wire EDM tab in EdmPage with a 6-step wizard that goes from file upload (DXF/photo/CAD) through drawing interpretation, feasibility, toolpath generation, multi-pass optimization, and controller-specific G-code output for 6 dialects. Leverages all 35 existing WEDM-P2P pipeline actions. Includes 2D profile canvas, WCS gizmo, Quick Generate fast track, and setup sheet output.
critical_findings_addressed: 2D polylines instead of THREE.ExtrudeGeometry (fixes arc/spline/hole failures)
Per-step local state instead of monolithic useReducer (fixes re-render storm)
Stale marking instead of cascading deletion (fixes hostile UX)
Multipart upload instead of base64 (fixes >10MB file failures)
New dedicated page at /wire-edm (fixes state collision with EdmPage)
DXF parser gap acknowledged — backend /interpret route must handle raw file
Taper cutting, corner handling, tab/slug mgmt all exposed in UI
Wire break prediction + surface integrity surfaced to user
Quick Generate fast track for simple jobs

engines: EDMProgramAssemblerEngine (2331 LOC) — full pipeline orchestrator, 6 G-code dialects
EDMToolpathStrategyEngine (1000 LOC) — profile classification, approach/departure, corner strategy
EDMMultiPassStrategyEngine (800 LOC) — pass cascade, Ra prediction, recast removal
EDMCuttingParamFlushEngine (1540 LOC) — pulse optimization, flushing, wire break prediction
EDMWireSlugCornerTaperEngine (1540 LOC) — wire management, corner compensation, taper UV solving
EDMMaterialMachineWireEngine (680 LOC) — material assessment, machine/wire selection
EDMFeasibilityEngine (680 LOC) — conductivity, geometry, tolerance feasibility
EDMStartHoleSetupEngine (960 LOC) — start hole planning, auto-threading
EDMDrawingInterpretationEngine (880 LOC) — feature classification (expects PartFeature[] input)
EDMMonitorSurfaceIntegrityEngine (1050 LOC) — recast, HAZ, residual stress prediction
EDMCostDocumentationEngine (1299 LOC) — wire cost, machine time, setup sheets
EDMQualityOrchestratorEngine (1675 LOC) — quality verification, full pipeline run
BlueprintOCREngine — dimension extraction from OCR text (NOT contour geometry)
formulas: Sato Wire EDM MRR: V_cut = (K × I_peak × t_on) / (h × D_wire)
Puertas & Luis: Ra = C_ra × I_peak^α × t_on^β
Rajurkar wire break: P(break) = 1 - exp(-λ × H × DC / FF)
Corner over-travel: OT = δ × sin(θ/2) / sin(θ)
reference: MachineRegistry — 910 machines including wire EDM specs
wedmPipelineActionSchemas.ts — Zod schemas for all 35 pipeline actions

sessions.title: Context + 2D Profile Canvas
sessions.intent: Lightweight context manages wizard navigation + step data. 2D canvas renders Wire EDM profiles with arcs, holes, toolpaths, and WCS indicator.

U-WEDM04.title: Create WedmStudioContext (split navigation + data)
U-WEDM04.description: Two contexts: WedmNavigationContext (currentStep, stepStatuses, setCurrentStep, markStale) and WedmDataContext (per-step result slots, setStepData, clearStep). Simple callbacks, NOT useReducer. sessionStorage for metadata. Debounce-on-mutation autosave (2s after last dispatch).

sessionStorage exceeds 5MB on complex jobs
Stale marking doesn't propagate to step badges
U-WEDM04.exit_gate: Context split verified: step component only re-renders on its own data change. Stale marking works. sessionStorage persists across refresh.
U-WEDM04.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE (state-management agent) → GAP FILL (perf test) → TIE UP (memo boundaries)

U-WEDM05.title: Create ProfileCanvas.tsx — 2D Wire EDM profile renderer
U-WEDM05.description: HTML5 Canvas 2D component rendering wire EDM profiles. Arc tessellation (circular arcs → polyline segments, configurable tolerance 0.01mm). Multiple contours: outer profile + inner holes, color-coded by feature type. Toolpath overlay: cutting direction arrows, approach/departure lines. WCS origin crosshair. Start hole markers. Tab markers. Multi-pass offset overlay (onion-skin). Zoom/pan via mouse wheel + drag. NO Three.js — pure Canvas 2D.
abort_criteria: Arcs render as straight lines (tessellation failure)
Inner holes not distinguished from outer profile
Canvas doesn't resize on window resize
Performance degrades with >500 contour segments
U-WEDM05.exit_gate: Renders DXF-like profiles with arcs tessellated to <0.01mm tolerance. 500+ segments at 60fps. Zoom/pan smooth. Colors per feature type.
U-WEDM05.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE (3D/graphics agent) → GAP FILL (edge cases: empty, single-point, self-intersecting) → TIE UP (responsive resize)

U-WEDM06.title: Create geometry utilities (wedmGeometry.ts)
U-WEDM06.description: Functions: tessellateArc(center, radius, startAngle, endAngle, tolerance) → points[]. contourToCanvasPath(contour: ProfileContour) → Path2D. featureToColor(featureType) → string. offsetContour(points, offset_mm) → points[] (for multi-pass onion-skin). calculateBounds(contours) → BBox. snapToGrid(point, gridSize) → point.
abort_criteria: Arc tessellation produces gaps or overlaps
Offset contour self-intersects on sharp corners
Bounds calculation wrong for profiles with arcs
U-WEDM06.exit_gate: All geometry functions unit-tested. Arc tessellation matches Three.js arc output within 0.001mm. Offset contour handles convex + concave corners.
U-WEDM06.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE (physics agent) → GAP FILL (unit tests) → TIE UP (edge case docs)

sessions.exit_gate: Context split passes re-render test. Canvas renders test profiles with arcs. Geometry utils 100% tested. tsc passes. omega_floor >= 0.85. SVI delta: +1%
